accuracy.pwin_window: minutes from >= 1% of boxes counted until both model and market stayed >= 0.9 on the provisional outcome; model P is the latest release's

profit.rule: frozen night rule: favoured side only, edge >= 5c after costs, >= 1% of the market counted, first signal per market, held to resolution
profit.execution: walk of the recorded order book 60 s after the signal as a limit order (levels leaving >= min_edge), incl. taker fee
profit.outcome: provisional count; markets not yet resolved

invest10k.execution: model limit: after the 1% gate, 10% of every real taker trade (Israel: resting ask in the recorded book) on the favoured side whose all-in price leaves the model >= 5c, using the model P known >= 60 s earlier; no per-market cap
invest10k.outcome: provisional count; markets not yet resolved
invest10k.note: totals only: every Israel bet rides on one election's count (one event); bet times, markets and the bankroll path are not published because they come from the 2026 count (private-research data)

signal_price.execution: walk of the recorded order book 60 s after the signal as a limit order (levels leaving >= 5c of edge), at the average cost of a $1,000 walk; taker fee 0
signal_price.outcome: provisional count; markets not yet resolved
signal_price.note: totals only: every Israel bet rides on one election's count (one event); bet times, markets and the bankroll path are not published because they come from the 2026 count (private-research data)
